installCommand: git config --global url."https://x-access-token:${GITHUB_TOKEN}@github.com/".insteadOf "https://github.com/" && git config --global --add url."https://x-access-token:${GITHUB_TOKEN}@github.com/".insteadOf "git@github.com:" && git config --global --add url."https://x-access-token:${GITHUB_TOKEN}@github.com/".insteadOf "ssh://git@github.com/" && pnpm install
ignoreCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" = "main" ] || [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" = "develop" ]; then exit 1; else exit 0; fi
